points.title: 童年时光
points.description: 凯末尔出生于奥斯曼帝国萨洛尼卡（今希腊境内）一个中产阶级家庭。他的父亲阿里·里扎是一位小官员，母亲祖贝伊德是一位虔诚的穆斯林。这段时期，奥斯曼帝国正处于衰落阶段，各种思潮涌动。凯末尔在当地的伊斯兰学校接受基础教育，展现出对学习的浓厚兴趣和独立思考的能力。这段童年经历为他后来的民族主义思想和世俗化理念埋下了种子。
points.descriptionEn: Mustafa Kemal was born in Thessaloniki, then part of the Ottoman Empire, to a middle-class family. His father Ali Riza was a minor official and his mother Zubeyde was a devout Muslim. During this period, the Ottoman Empire was in decline with various ideological currents. Kemal received his basic education in Islamic schools, showing strong interest in learning and independent thinking. This childhood experience laid the foundation for his later nationalist and secular ideas.

points.title: 军事教育
points.description: 凯末尔进入伊斯坦布尔的军事学院学习，展现出卓越的军事才能和领导能力。1902年，他进入总参谋部学院深造，接触到了欧洲的军事思想和政治理念。在此期间，他开始对奥斯曼帝国的腐败和落后感到不满，萌生了改革思想。他的军事才能得到了认可，被派往阿尔巴尼亚、利比亚等地执行任务，积累了宝贵的军事经验。
points.descriptionEn: Kemal entered the military school in Istanbul, where he demonstrated exceptional military talent and leadership abilities. In 1902, he entered the War Academy, where he was exposed to European military thought and political ideas. During this time, he became increasingly dissatisfied with the corruption and backwardness of the Ottoman Empire, developing reformist ideas. His military skills were recognized, and he was sent to places like Albania and Libya on missions, gaining valuable military experience.

points.title: 战争英雄
points.description: 第一次世界大战期间，凯末尔被派往加里波利半岛指挥防御。面对协约国的强大攻势，他展现出卓越的军事才能和坚定的意志，成功击退了英法联军的登陆企图。这场胜利使他成为奥斯曼帝国的民族英雄，赢得了'伊斯坦布尔救星'的称号。加里波利战役的胜利不仅挽救了奥斯曼帝国免于过早崩溃，也奠定了凯末尔在军队中的崇高地位，为他后来的政治生涯奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: During World War I, Kemal was sent to the Gallipoli Peninsula to command the defense. Facing the powerful Allied forces, he demonstrated exceptional military talent and unwavering determination, successfully repelling the British and French landing attempts. This victory made him a national hero of the Ottoman Empire, earning him the title 'Savior of Istanbul.' The Gallipoli victory not only saved the Ottoman Empire from early collapse but also established Kemal's prestigious position in the military, laying the foundation for his later political career.

points.title: 独立战争
points.description: 奥斯曼帝国在一战战败后，协约国计划瓜分土耳其领土。凯末尔被派往安纳托利亚组织抵抗，但他很快与伊斯坦布尔政府决裂，领导土耳其民族解放运动。他在安卡拉建立了大国民议会政府，组织了土耳其国民军，领导了艰苦的独立战争。经过三年的浴血奋战，凯末尔成功击退了希腊、亚美尼亚等国的入侵，迫使协约国重新签订《洛桑条约》，承认土耳其的独立和主权。这场战争使凯末尔成为土耳其民族解放的象征。
points.descriptionEn: After the Ottoman Empire's defeat in World War I, the Allied powers planned to partition Turkish territory. Kemal was sent to Anatolia to organize resistance, but he soon broke with the Istanbul government and led the Turkish national liberation movement. He established the Grand National Assembly government in Ankara, organized the Turkish National Army, and led a grueling War of Independence. After three years of fierce fighting, Kemal successfully repelled invasions from Greece, Armenia and others, forcing the Allies to renegotiate the Treaty of Lausanne, recognizing Turkey's independence and sovereignty. This war made Kemal the symbol of Turkish national liberation.

points.title: 国家建设
points.description: 1923年，土耳其共和国正式成立，安卡拉取代伊斯坦布尔成为新首都。凯末尔作为共和国第一任总统，开始了一系列激进的现代化改革。他废除了哈里发制度，推行拉丁字母代替阿拉伯字母，给予妇女选举权，实施世俗教育，改革法律体系，推动工业化。这些改革彻底改变了土耳其的社会结构和生活方式，将一个传统的伊斯兰国家转变为现代化的世俗共和国。安卡拉成为凯末尔实施其改革理念的中心，见证了他如何塑造现代土耳其的方方面面。
points.descriptionEn: In 1923, the Republic of Turkey was formally established, with Ankara replacing Istanbul as the new capital. As the first president of the republic, Kemal initiated a series of radical modernization reforms. He abolished the caliphate, replaced the Arabic script with Latin alphabet, granted women voting rights, implemented secular education, reformed the legal system, and promoted industrialization. These reforms fundamentally transformed Turkey's social structure and lifestyle, turning a traditional Islamic state into a modern secular republic. Ankara became the center for implementing Kemal's reform vision, witnessing how he shaped every aspect of modern Turkey.

points.title: 晚年岁月
points.description: 1934年，土耳其大国民议会授予凯末尔'阿塔图尔克'（土耳其之父）的姓氏。晚年时期，他继续致力于巩固共和国的成果，同时健康状况逐渐恶化。他经常前往伊斯坦布尔疗养，但仍密切关注国家事务。在这期间，他进一步完善了法律体系，推动了文化教育改革，并开始培养接班人。1938年11月10日，凯末尔在伊斯坦布尔的多尔玛巴赫切宫逝世，享年57岁。他的去世标志着土耳其一个时代的结束，但他的改革遗产和民族主义思想继续影响着土耳其的发展方向。
points.descriptionEn: In 1934, the Turkish Grand National Assembly granted Kemal the surname 'Atatürk' (Father of the Turks). In his later years, he continued to consolidate the achievements of the republic while his health gradually deteriorated. He often traveled to Istanbul for treatment but remained closely involved in state affairs. During this period, he further improved the legal system, promoted cultural and educational reforms, and began cultivating successors. On November 10, 1938, Atatürk died at Dolmabahçe Palace in Istanbul at the age of 57. His death marked the end of an era in Turkey, but his reform legacy and nationalist ideas continue to influence the country's development.

appraisal.zh: 学界公认凯末尔是20世纪最具转型意义的人物之一，他领导独立战争并以世俗化、现代化和教育改革把衰落的帝国带入现代民族国家行列，其形象遍及货币、邮票与公共建筑，被视为世俗现代的象征。也有研究者指出，这些改革激进且带有强制性，对伊斯兰传统形成压制，文字改革造成文化断裂，其一党威权统治与对反对派的压制、以及对库尔德少数民族的政策长期引发争议，现代化成就与社会分裂、文化断层并存。
appraisal.en: Atatürk is widely regarded as one of the 20th century's most transformative figures, whose war of independence and secularizing, modernizing, educational reforms brought a declining empire into the ranks of modern nation-states; his image on currency, stamps and public buildings makes him a symbol of secular modernity. Yet researchers also note the reforms were radical and coercive, suppressing Islamic tradition and causing cultural rupture through the alphabet change, while his one-party authoritarian rule, suppression of opposition and policies toward Kurdish minorities remain contested, so modernization came with social division and cultural dislocation.

supporter.zh: 凯末尔被土耳其人民尊为民族英雄和现代国家的奠基人。支持者认为他通过一系列大胆的改革，成功将一个衰落的奥斯曼帝国转变为现代化的世俗共和国，挽救了土耳其的民族独立和文化认同。他推行的世俗化、现代化和教育改革为土耳其的发展奠定了基础，使土耳其成为中东地区最现代化的国家之一。凯末尔的思想和遗产至今仍是土耳其民族认同的核心部分，被尊为'土耳其之父'。
supporter.en: Atatürk is revered by the Turkish people as a national hero and the founder of the modern state. Supporters argue that through a series of bold reforms, he successfully transformed the declining Ottoman Empire into a modern secular republic, saving Turkey's national independence and cultural identity. The secularization, modernization, and educational reforms he implemented laid the foundation for Turkey's development, making it one of the most modern countries in the Middle East. Atatürk's ideas and legacy remain central to Turkish national identity, honored as the 'Father of the Turks'.

critic.zh: 批评者认为凯末尔的改革过于激进和强制，忽视了土耳其的传统文化和宗教价值。他的世俗化政策被视为对伊斯兰传统的压制，强制推行拉丁字母等措施被批评为文化断裂。此外，他的威权统治方式、对反对派的压制以及一党制政治体制也受到批评。一些批评者指出，凯末尔的民族主义思想有时排外，特别是对库尔德少数民族的政策引发了长期争议。这些批评者认为，虽然凯末尔的改革带来了现代化，但也造成了社会分裂和文化断层。
critic.en: Critics argue that Atatürk's reforms were too radical and coercive, neglecting Turkey's traditional cultural and religious values. His secularization policies are seen as suppressing Islamic traditions, and measures like the forced adoption of the Latin alphabet are criticized as causing cultural rupture. Additionally, his authoritarian style of rule, suppression of opposition, and one-party political system have drawn criticism. Some critics point out that his nationalist ideas were at times exclusionary, particularly toward Kurdish minorities, leading to long-term controversies. These critics believe that while Atatürk's reforms brought modernization, they also caused social division and cultural dislocation.

objective.zh: 从历史学角度看，凯末尔是20世纪最具影响力的转型人物之一。他领导的土耳其独立战争和随后的现代化改革，代表了传统帝国向现代民族国家转变的典型案例。在流行文化中，凯末尔常被塑造成世俗化、现代化的象征，其形象出现在土耳其的货币、邮票和公共建筑上。历史学界普遍承认，尽管他的改革存在争议，但确实将土耳其带入了现代国家行列。他的遗产复杂而深远，既包括成功的现代化成就，也包括威权统治的遗产，这些因素共同塑造了现代土耳其的政治文化和社会发展轨迹。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, Atatürk is one of the most transformative figures of the 20th century. The Turkish War of Independence he led and subsequent modernization reforms represent a classic case of transition from traditional empire to modern nation-state. In popular culture, Atatürk is often portrayed as a symbol of secularization and modernization, his image appearing on Turkish currency, stamps, and public buildings. Historians generally acknowledge that despite the controversies surrounding his reforms, he successfully brought Turkey into the ranks of modern nations. His legacy is complex and profound, encompassing both successful modernization achievements and authoritarian rule, factors that have collectively shaped modern Turkey's political culture and developmental trajectory.

self.zh: 和平在家庭中，和平在国家中，和平在世界中。
self.en: Peace at home, peace in the world.
